name: BestPrice
description: Read-only shopping decisions, product search, current Greek merchant offers, and price history for physical products sold in Greece. Not an ordering or payment agent.

skills.name: Get a shopping decision
skills.description: Recommend, compare, or plan a read-only basket for a physical product need in Greece.

skills.name: Search products
skills.description: Find a canonical BestPrice product by name, model, category, or barcode.

skills.name: Compare offers
skills.description: Compare current Greek merchant offers and delivered totals for one exact product.

skills.name: Inspect price history
skills.description: Classify today's item price against the product's 180-day median.
